scope: Post-hoc geometric stratification of completed UJI117 and TIE1 F0 three-budget tasks; dataset summaries remain separate.

protocol.name: static-resample-v2
protocol.query_pairing: Identical recorded Query rows/groups/meta across methods and budgets, verified again against reconstructed official data. Each group XY is verified equal across all scans in that group. Support is reconstructed using the complete nested K1/K3/K5 sequence.
protocol.unit: One Query position within one sampling repeat at the listed K. UJI r0/r1/r2 retain their original identities; repetitions can revisit physical positions.
protocol.K_handling: Each summary is at one K. Geometry families pair the same Q across K. Counts from separate K summaries are repeated observations.
protocol.error: Mean Euclidean scan error within Query group; then pooled position-repeat mean/P90 within the listed stratum.
protocol.interpretation: Descriptive associations using actual Query XY for analysis. S-distance strata have K-specific membership. All errors come from previously saved completed method events.

tampere_TIE1_F0.scope: Completed TIE1 F0 subset only; floor selected by source-field cost before localization results.

frozen_thresholds.threshold_selection: Use the frozen translator radii unchanged for all datasets and all three distance axes.
frozen_thresholds.AP_bin_selection: Natural availability endpoints only; no error-based cutpoints.

geometry_definition.distance: 2D Euclidean metres in the frozen common XY frame. All H is every legal other target-building floor. Slot H uses the frozen translator SLOTS only. Each Query group has one verified actual XY.
geometry_definition.local_AP: At the actual Query XY, number of AP columns detected (!=100) in at least one slot-H scan within R_SMOOTH, divided by AP columns detected anywhere in slot H. This is a post-hoc H-only availability fraction, with no Query RSS or labels entering inference.
geometry_definition.local_AP_denominator: Union of AP columns detected anywhere in the legal translator-slot H floors for that task family.
geometry_definition.history_scope_note: All selected UJI target floors and TIE1 F0 have all permitted H within the frozen ±4 slots. The two saved H-distance axes therefore have identical membership on this scope.
geometry_definition.grouping_information: Ground-truth Query coordinates assign post-hoc strata. Their availability belongs to evaluation. The inference information remains the H/S/Q RSS used by the completed runs.
